podcast.title: "England's Dean Martin" Ambition
podcast.body: Malcolm Vaughan was a British pop tenor who aspired to be known as "England's Dean Martin." "Malcolm Vaughan, a pop tenor who wanted to be England's censor to Dean Martin."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Controversial UK Cover of "St. Therese of the Roses"
podcast.body: Vaughan's cover version of Jackie Wilson's "St. Therese of the Roses" became a massive hit in the UK, reaching number 3, despite being banned by the BBC for being contrary to Roman Catholic doctrine and Protestant sentiment. "That version actually became a massive hit over here, reaching number 3 after being banned by the BBC."

podcast.title: Cover of "To Be Loved"
podcast.body: Vaughan later achieved a minor hit with a cover version of another Jackie Wilson record, "To Be Loved." "Vaughan would later go on to have a minor hit, with the cover version of another Jackie Wilson record, to be loved."
